PHPUnit 10+ recommends the #[DataProvider] attribute over the deprecated @dataProvider docblock annotation for passing test data.
PHPUnit allows test dependencies via the @depends annotation, which lets one test method depend on the result of another and receive its return value.
The PHPUnit option --order-by=random (or --random-order in older versions) causes tests to execute in a random order rather than the default sequence.
